name: LibreTranslate
description: Machine translation you host yourself, with a web page and an API.

paths.name: .Local
paths.description: The downloaded language models, so they are not downloaded again after an update.

paths.name: Db
paths.description: The API keys database, when API keys are turned on.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: LibreTranslate web page and API, published on host as 6737

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: LT_LOAD_ONLY
variables.description: The languages to download and load, as two-letter codes, comma separated, like en,es,fr,de,it,ja. Fewer languages means a faster start and less memory. Leave it blank for all of them (about 10 GB and a lot of memory).

variables.name: LT_UPDATE_MODELS
variables.description: true downloads newer language models when they come out, on start. Set to false to keep the ones you have.
